final_text:
The catalog-wide Bonferroni-corrected significance threshold for the NHANES EP-WAS meta-analysis is **6.67e-9**.

This threshold is derived from a 0.05 significance level divided by the **7,500,000** total statistical tests performed in the catalog (approximately 1,500 exposures multiplied by 5,000 phenotypes). This stringent correction is used to control the family-wise error rate across the entire exposome-phenome matrix. The number of tests is the same for all adjustment models, including model 6.
